messages:
elena: Reminder — MedSync POC finishes next Tue. Need final steps for VPC handback, revoke hosted API key, teardown dedicated pool, and S3 retention purge. Who owns?
tyler.s: I can own the infra teardown (VPC routing + pool). Need confirmation on data retention from legal before purge.
elena: Customer contact is rachel@medsync (rachel-ms). Resources: hosted key hk-MSD9, dedicated pool ms-pool-7, S3 bucket s3://medsync-poc-logs.
sam.sales: Pricing note for handoff: customer asked if we can offer a 30-day audit hold for logs as a one-off. We agreed to standard 90d unless legal signs off.
liz.legal: We can accept 30d for POCs if security sign-off completed. Please provide a formal request email and list of data types retained.
tyler.s: Plan for pool: 1) cordon pool 2) wait 45m for in-flight 3) snapshot KV cache and model weights 4) delete pool. I'll schedule drain Tue 18:00 PT.
infra-automation: Automation note: snapshot job created `snap-ms-177123` and will upload to internal S3 at gs://redwood-snapshots/ms/177123.
osps-bot: (typo) ignore
ops-bot: Ops ticket created REDW-5982 with checklist: VPC peering removal, NAT rule cleanup, s3 lifecycle, key rotation. Assigned to tyler.s.
elena: For hosted key revoke we use internal endpoint: `POST /admin/keys/hk-MSD9/revoke` with body `{reason: "poc_end"}`. Please wait until snapshots complete.
tyler.s: Will not revoke until snapshot confirms checksum OK. Snapshot checksum: `sha256:9f8b...d2`.
liz.legal: Confirmed via thread that 30d retention is OK. Please document audit path and grant readonly DB access for 30d.
sam.sales: Customer acknowledged planned schedule and approved 30d audit hold.
infra-automation: Draining pool ms-pool-7 started by tyler.s at 1771237200 — progress: 100% allocations evicted.
tyler.s: Pool deleted at 1771239000. I removed VPC peering and NAT rules. Please verify access from their side is cut.
elena: Revoking hosted key hk-MSD9 now. `curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/admin/keys/hk-MSD9/revoke -d '{"reason":"poc_end"}'` -> 200 OK. :lock:
ops-bot: S3 bucket lifecycle set to 30d for retention: s3://medsync-poc-logs. Purge scheduled at 1773836567.
elena: Created audit readonly DB user medsync_audit with expiration 30d and stored creds in their vault.
sam.sales: Thanks team — action items done. I'll send wrap-up email and close the ticket once purge window starts. :email:
liz.legal: Saving thread for records. Make sure to attach snapshots to ticket.
infra-automation: Snapshot `snap-ms-177123` attached to REDW-5982.
elena: Closing loop — customer confirmed receipt and no outstanding requests. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
